title: Swamp Witch's Balcony
description: A woman with elaborate magenta hair and a green Victorian dress stands on a wooden balcony overlooking a misty swamp at dusk. She holds a glowing purple energy whip in one hand and a glowing purple sword in the other, with a hamburger, french fries, and a bottle of hot sauce floating before her as a massive purple storm with a cartoon cloud and tentacles swirls in the sky above a cypress tree.
prompt: A woman with bright magenta hair in an ornate updo stands on the porch of a wooden house in a misty Louisiana swamp at sunset. She wears a green and gold Victorian dress with a white ruffled collar and holds a glowing purple energy whip in her right hand while a glowing purple sword rests on a table. A hamburger, french fries, and hot sauce float in front of her. In the background a giant cypress tree stands in the water as a massive purple swirling storm cloud with lightning, a cartoon face, and giant green tentacles emerges from the sky. Spanish moss, purple flowers, a heron, and a black cat in a hammock are visible.
